text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(The Japan Cup... Highly rated, and 
definitely the one to be most wary of is—)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Well, no matter how you look at it right 
now, it's definitely 'Kitasan Black'.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ! ...Crown-san.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'm trying to push the analysis as far as 
I can too, though... frankly, there's a 
good chance it will all end up in vain.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Because that girl's growth rate is just a 
bit unnatural."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Last autumn... I figured she was hitting 
her stride around the Kikuka Sho, but 
still.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
To put it plainly, her growth curve since 
the start of this spring has been 
completely abnormal.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Continuing to surpass predicted growth 
every single day... Honestly, I have no 
idea how far she'll develop by the Japan 
Cup.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
So, well, the truth is that even if we 
wanted to come up with a countermeasure, 
it's hard to set a clear direction.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Watching your training runs and mock 
races, it seems Kita-san often takes the 
lead or runs up front, but—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
That must be because you're confident in 
both your speed and your stamina...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
“Still, when it comes to stamina... I-I 
won't lose either. ...So—”

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
If I want to turn it into a stamina 
contest at Tokyo... I suppose what I can 
do is prepare for the steep slope... like 
minimizing my deceleration on the uphill.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
And then, polishing skills like splitting 
through gaps without losing momentum, or 
taking the inside track...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, what?!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
S-Sorry, did I... say something completely 
off-base?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...—No, not in the least!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Just as I thought. Nicely done, Cheval. 
You truly possess that kind of strength.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I told you before, didn't I? You treat 
others with respect and face them head-on. 
That's the very source of the strength 
you've gained.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
You have faced Kitasan's strength head-on, 
and on top of that, recognized your own 
strengths.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, you taught me well! You're right, 
there's no point fearing Kitasan like 
she's some mysterious monster.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Just do what needs to be done, as always! 
...Fufu, it feels like I've just been 
slapped across the face.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Eep...!? I-I would never do something like 
that to Crown-san... !?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ah ha ha ha! Just kidding, but that sounds 
fun too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Still, truly. You've grown so strong, 
Cheval.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"So, yeah. —I'm keeping my guard up around 
you too, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
There's no denying Kitasan is strong. 
Judging from how she looked on that TV 
special the other day, though—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, you're the most unnerving one 
of all. ...I'm watching you, Cheval 
Grand."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Miss Crown—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, I unexpectedly got some great 
info just now♪ Hmm, hmm, an inner-track 
skill to handle steep slopes, huh~?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh, ah!? Wait, I for— Aaaaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha, it's fine, it's totally fine! 
You're going to outperform my analysis 
anyway, right? Isn't that right, Cheval!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, Cheval Grand continued to 
train tirelessly, dauntless even in the 
face of overwhelmingly powerful rivals."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The days leading up to the Japan Cup flew 
by in the blink of an eye—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Finally, the early morning of race day 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —Hello, Shine?

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
"...The sound of waves. Cheval-chan, are 
you at the beach?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...Honestly, I couldn't sleep well 
because of the nerves. Being here... calms 
me down.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I'm the same as ever, aren't I? 
After making that victory declaration and 
everything... Even now, my heart's 
trembling non-stop.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text: "Cheval-chan..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: B-But—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
It's fine like this. Even if I'm just a 
scared, cowardly person.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"That's precisely why I believe... I'll be 
able to properly hold your hand right 
now."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I'm off, Shine.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'll show you that I can become a 
"great Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... It's dazzling today too, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After leaving the waiting room with her 
all prepared, just before sending her off 
to the paddock... Cheval Grand quietly 
murmured something.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, um. ...Whenever I walk here, I 
often think about it. About what lies 
ahead on that path—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
That place where you step out before 
everyone. ...I wondered how it could be so 
dazzling.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Stepping out into the dazzling light is 
scary... Even now, I'm still terrified."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Even so, I can keep walking forward.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Because you were the very first one to 
lead me out into the dazzling light.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Because you gave me—someone who was always 
cowering in the dark—a dream to hold high.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Today, too... I'll keep walking forward.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to make it come true. ...My 
dream, that is.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Cheval Grand stepped forward into 
the light. Step by step, firmly treading 
upon the earth with her own two feet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Awaiting ahead are indisputably formidable 
rivals.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the intrepid Umamusume who transformed 
into a monster that shook the era.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Yet through it all she pushed forward, 
standing tall and proud before the crowd."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I'm Cheval Grand. Nice to meet you.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Today, we―

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
A victory that reaches across the sea! 
I've come to show it to you!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Loudly, proudly, she declared just that.
